-----

<a id="understand-the-implementation"></a>
## Understand the implementation

<details>
<summary>Implementation internals — click to expand</summary>

One `conversation.chat.turnTail` entry reads the `actionCards` Session projection and shows the card admitted in its Turn after that Turn has ended with a final answer; a Turn that ends without answer text shows no card, and should several cards share a Turn, the lowest call id is shown. The frame sets `data-action-card` to the call id and names its region by the card title. Folding counts a wide grapheme, such as a Chinese character, as two Latin-letter widths and folds after about 260; it never measures layout or alters the full text.

A `tool.call.toolview` entry keyed `propose_action` renders the process row from the recorded call arguments and result. The plugin provides the body registry at

===== conversation.chat @27952160 =====
�文把 `summary` 放进自己的布局，并负责自己的标题栏、控件、状态和底部操作。为同一动作注册第二个正文属于注册错误。

-----

<a id="understand-the-implementation"></a>
## 实现原理

<details>
<summary>实现细节——点击展开</summary>

一个 `conversation.chat.turnTail` 条目读取 `actionCards` 会话投影，在某一轮以最终回答结束后展示该轮接受的卡片；没有回答文本就结束的轮次不显示卡片，若同一轮有多张卡片，显示调用 id 最小的一张。框架把 `data-action-card` 设为调用 id，并以卡片标题命名所在区域。折叠时，宽字素（如汉字）按两个拉丁字母宽度计算，约 260 个单位后折叠；折叠不测量布局，也不改动完整文本。

一个以 `propose_action` 为键的 `tool.call.toolview` 条目，根据记录的调用参数和结果渲染过程行。插件在顶层提供正文注册表，然后挂载生成的 `actionCards` Remote，�
